=== --help
$ orion-agent --help

 ◆ orion-agent  monitor this host and report to Orion Core

 USAGE   orion-agent <command> [flags]

 START HERE
   setup     connect this host and choose what to monitor
   doctor    check everything and fix what is wrong
   status    see what the agent is doing right now

 DAY TO DAY
   logs      read agent and shipped logs
   config    show, diff, validate and edit settings
   update    upgrade safely, with rollback
   service   start, stop, restart, install

 EXAMPLES
   $ orion-agent setup
   $ orion-agent logs --follow --level warn
   $ orion-agent status --short

 More: enroll · discover · usage · maintenance · token · version · run

=== errors
$ orion-agent config validate

 ERROR  Invalid config

   /etc/orion/config.yaml:14:3
   13 │   interval: 30s
   14 │   intervall: 30s
      │   ^^^^^^^^^ unknown key

   Did you mean interval?

   Fix   orion-agent config edit
   Docs  https://orion.thesunday.studio/docs/config
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$ orion-agent statsu

 ERROR  Unknown command "statsu"
   Did you mean status?  Run orion-agent --help for all commands.
 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
$ orion-agent start

 ERROR  Cannot start: state database is not writable
   /var/lib/orion/state.db is owned by root
   Fix   sudo orion-agent start   or   orion-agent doctor

--- notes
NOTE Fang does the work: Styled Cobra help and errors are already in the agent. This tightens the layout and adds examples that are real commands.
NOTE Intent, not alphabet: Start here, Day to day, then a one-line list of the rest, so no command is hidden.
NOTE Errors are three lines: What went wrong, where, and the fix. Code frames show the exact line. Suggestions use edit distance.
NOTE Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed or errors, 2 usage error, 3 needs elevation (run with sudo). Listed in the output modes board.
